jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Summary**

GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale.

**Role & Responsibilities**

As a Project Coordinator, you will join our Aerospace & Defense team onsite in our Carson, CA office to keep aerospace and defense robot cell projects moving from design through deployment and activation:

**Robot cell design**

* Maintain the project schedule, milestone tracker, and action log for each robot cell design effort, in close coordination with the Project Lead Engineer
* Organize design reviews, capture decisions and open items, and follow up until each item closes
* Track customer requirements, part and process specifications, and change requests, and keep revision control on shared documentation
* Coordinate with mechanical, controls, software, and process engineers so that inputs arrive when the final design needs to be locked in

**Deployment**

* Manage procurement tracking, supplier lead times, and delivery status for cell components, tooling, fixtures, and safety hardware
* Plan shipping, receiving, and site logistics, including customs and export documentation handled with GMR compliance
* Build and maintain installation plans, site readiness checklists, and travel schedules for the deployment team
* Serve as a point of contact for customer facilities, security, and EHS teams on access, badging, and scheduling

**Activation**

* Prepare commissioning and acceptance test plans with the Project Lead Engineer, and track each step through completion
* Record punch list items, test results, and customer sign offs, and assemble the turnover package
* Coordinate operator training sessions and handoff to GMR support teams for ongoing service

**Project administration**

* Prepare weekly status reports covering schedule, budget, risks, and decisions needed, for GMR leadership and customer stakeholders
* Track project budgets, purchase orders, and invoicing milestones with Finance
* Maintain a risk and issue register and raise schedule or scope concerns early
* Own deadline tracking for each project: monitor milestone and deliverable dates, escalate at risk items to the Project Lead Engineer promptly, and drive follow up so commitments to customers are met
* Apply ITAR and customer information handling requirements to every document, file, and communication

**Export Control Requirements**

In order to comply with the export regulations of the United States Government, it is required that the applicant must fall under one of the following categories: (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (i.e. current green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing operations, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience supporting robotics, automation, or capital equipment installations from design through commissioning
* 2 to 4 years of project coordination, program support, or project management experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or industrial automation
* Demonstrated record of meeting deadlines, including tracking milestones, flagging risks early, and following up until work is delivered
* Working knowledge of project scheduling and tracking tools such as ClickUp, MS Project, or Smartsheet, plus strong Excel skills
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to brief engineers, executives, and customer stakeholders
* A reliable self-starter, highly organized, resourceful, with attention to detail, and the ability to manage several workstreams at once
* Ability to travel to customer sites, typically for short trips when needed, and work onsite at GMR
* Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across multiple teams
* Willingness to work in a fast-paced environment with quickly changing priorities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with aerospace and defense manufacturing environments and customer requirements, including AS9100 quality practices
* Understanding of ITAR, EAR, CUI handling, and export documentation
* Exposure to factory acceptance and site acceptance testing
* Working toward a PMP, CAPM, or similar project management qualification
* Ability to obtain a U.S. government security clearance if a program requires it

*GrayMatter Robotics provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage and embrace applicants of all backgrounds to apply!*

jobs.title: Intake Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Come join an exciting and innovative company that puts the “care” back in healthcare!**

At KabaFusion, our patients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire GREAT people, period! Our culture celebrates and supports the differences that make us unique. Here, it doesn’t matter what your role is, your hard work and dedication is not only recognized but celebrated. Join us and find out why this is the place to excel and do your best work.

**About Us:**

What started as a single pharmacy in 2010 has grown into KabaFusion becoming the largest privately held home infusion company in the country. We have a national network of pharmacies and nursing offices strategically placed to service 40+ states. Couple that with over 30 years of combined experience and it’s no wonder why KabaFusion is the industry leader in home infusion.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

This position is responsible for the coordination and supports the intake function, managing intake documentation, payor requirements, and cross-functional scheduling to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. This role blends operational rigor with light project management, serving as a liaison between intake staff and leadership to drive process improvements and maintain compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

1. Write, maintain, and update Intake Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to reflect current workflows, policy changes, and best practices.

2. Maintain and update the payor handbook, including payor-specific requirements, timelines, and submission guidelines; track policy changes and translate them into actionable process updates.

3. Manage calendars and schedule intake-related meetings across departments (operations, clinical, billing, etc.).

4. Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, minutes, and follow-up action items to ensure timely execution.

5. Maintain project documentation for intake process improvement initiatives, including action logs, scope changes, and post-project evaluations.

6. Serve as a liaison between intake staff and leadership to support process improvement project implementation.

7. Review, categorize, and ensure accurate and timely distribution of incoming faxes and other intake documentation to the appropriate department or stakeholders.

8. Monitor intake processes for adherence to SOPs and payor requirements; identify recurring issues or bottlenecks and propose solutions.

9. Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA) and organizational standards.

10. Perform other duties as assigned by leadership to support departmental goals.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

Education:

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

Experience:

* Minimum of two (2) years of experience in operations, intake, project coordination, or a related role; healthcare or revenue cycle management experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build stakeholder engagement and drive action.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams) and/or electronic health record or payor portal systems preferred.

Skills and Competencies:

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent workstreams.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive compensation
* **Benefits start on your 1st day of employment**
* **401k w 4% match – no waiting or vesting period**
* PTO / Floating Holidays / Paid Holidays
* Company paid life insurance, short term disability
* Employee Assistance programs to help with mental health / wellness
* Learning & Development Programs
* Perks… includes discounts on travel, cell phone, clothing and more…
* Generous employee referral program

**To learn more about KabaFusion, please visit our careers page:** **https://www.kabafusion.com/careers/**

jobs.title: Shelter Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Full Time – Non-Exempt (40 hrs/wk)  
Starting Hourly Rate: $29.33.00 - $31.74/hr

**Make a difference in your community.** Do you believe in working towards justice through your direct advocacy? Do you want to join the team in the efforts towards self-determination, nonviolence practices and violence prevention for the benefit of API communities and those impacted by violence against women? The Center for the Pacific Asian Family is looking for a passionate and committed individual to fit that role!

**Center for the Pacific Asian Family (CPAF)** is a non-profit organization recognized nationally for its pioneering work in domestic violence and sexual assault. CPAF’s multi-lingual and multi-cultural services include a 24-hour hotline, short term and long-term shelters, counseling, case management, and supportive services. CPAF also provides violence prevention programs, outreach, education and advocacy on the issues of family violence and violence against women, focusing on the Asian and Pacific Islander community.

CPAF is a community-based organization that draws from multiple disciplines to holistically serve individuals and families of many different sizes and cultural backgrounds. Staff work in environments where children are present and may be called upon to provide support as needed.

**Summary Statement:**

The Shelter Program Coordinator (SPC) position provides services across both TH Programs (TSN & TSSB) as a non-exempt position working 40 hours a week with domestic violence and sexual assault survivors and reporting to the Shelter Program Manager. Workdays will mainly consist of Monday–Friday, with occasional Saturdays for special events. Work hours will vary between 8am and 8pm, depending on programming and scheduled shifts (opener/closer). The schedule will also consist of one work-from-home day, 2 days at TSN, and 2 days at TSSB.

The SPC works collaboratively with other coordinators, Family Advocates, and the SPM. The SPC is tasked with evaluating the impact of programming for both adults and children. The SPC supports survivors of domestic and sexual violence and their children entering our TH Program through relocation assistance, case management, emotional support, and supportive services. The SPC will also hold a caseload of 4 families at TSSB only and support groups at both sites. The SPC will work closely with the SPM to engage and coordinate interns/volunteers to support the program.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* *Program Development and Implementation:* Collaborate with SPC colleagues to develop, implement, coordinate, and evaluate in-shelter and post-shelter workshops & activities with and for survivors and their children; engage and develop volunteers, interns and community partners to support program activities, including taking the lead on volunteer coordination, language interpretation/translation and engagement; communicate and collaborate with colleague to meet the survivor interests and programmatic needs. Create developmentally appropriate programming for children and youth with a focus on Mommy & Me, Healthy Play/Relationships, Windows Between Worlds, and/or family activities. Coordinate with SPM on adult workshops with a focus on delivering Parenting, DV/SA Workshops, Financial Literacy Workshops, & Career/Employment Workshops.
* *Direct Service:* Work closely with team members when onboarding new survivors and conduct orientation, intake, and assessment of families into the TH program; meet weekly with survivors to develop goal-oriented action plans; provide case management for survivors and their children; provide emotional support/counseling services; provide advocacy and accompaniment to survivors for their legal, court, housing, public benefits, and medical appointments and other meetings as necessary; update Housing Referral Form (HRF), provide safety education, provide resources and referrals to community partners, collaborate with the Housing Coordinator and other relevant team members; and maintain up-to-date files on participants and program activities. Enter EDB notes in a timely manner.
* *Program Administration:* Work with Shelter Program Manager to provide necessary programmatic information by established grant deadlines; work with teammates to ensure relevant forms and files pertaining to residents are complete.
* *Travel requirements:* Driving is an essential job function for this position. A valid CA driver’s license is required if using employee’s own vehicle or agency vehicle to perform duties. The employee must show proof of insurance for own vehicle and must also be eligible for coverage under CPAF’s auto insurance policy.
* *Teamwork:* Provide general support asked of all staff which may include responding to emergencies, site coverage, providing translation, maintaining a functioning office. Participate in program and organizational development and attend staff and team meetings.
* *Outreach:* Identify/create opportunities to be an ambassador for CPAF’s mission.

**Core Competencies/Minimum Standard:** The qualified candidate must demonstrate at least the minimum standard in these core competencies:

* *Communication:* Uses effective written and oral communication with internal staff, teams, and community served; demonstrates empathy and listening.

jobs.title: Administrative Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join the forefront of groundbreaking research at the Beckman Research Institute of City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. Our dedicated and compassionate faculty and staff are driven by a common mission: Contribute to innovative approaches in predicting, preventing, and curing diseases, shaping the future of medicine through cutting-edge research.

We are looking for an Administrative Program Coordinator to support the department of Molecular Diagnostics and Experimental Therapeutics (MDET). You will provide high‑level administrative, programmatic, and operational support to senior faculty leadership and departmental programs. The position performs a broad range of complex, diversified, and confidential administrative duties requiring independent judgment, discretion, and a high degree of professionalism. Your responsibilities will include executive calendar and meeting management, coordination of research and academic programs, faculty affairs and recruitment support, financial and business operations assistance, and liaison with internal and external stakeholders.

This role requires exceptional organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, research‑intensive environment. You will serve as a key partner to faculty leadership by anticipating needs, streamlining workflows, and ensuring administrative, compliance, and operational processes are executed efficiently and in alignment with institutional policies. The position requires flexibility, strong communication skills, and the ability to work independently while contributing to the overall success of the department and institution.

**As a successful candidate you will:**

* Provide high-level administrative support to senior faculty leadership, managing complex calendars, meetings, competing priorities, confidential communications, and scheduling needs.
* Coordinate departmental programs, research initiatives, projects, faculty recruitment, and administrative activities supporting academic and institutional goals.
* Manage logistics for research meetings, seminars, symposiums, visitors, and special events, including scheduling, materials, speakers, technology, and travel arrangements.
* Support financial and business operations through budget tracking, purchasing, expense reporting, procurement card reconciliation, account monitoring, and transaction reconciliation.
* Coordinate faculty affairs and HR processes, including appointments, promotions, onboarding/offboarding, Global Scholars Program activities, visa documentation, and compliance requirements.
* Serve as a key liaison for faculty, collaborators, visiting scholars, vendors, and internal departments, supporting recruitment, outreach, and cross-functional communication.
* Maintain faculty and departmental information, including CVs, biosketches, professional profiles, publications, research metrics, websites, reports, databases, shared files, and communications.
* Oversee day-to-day office operations, including workspace coordination, supplies, equipment, facilities requests, visitor logistics, and general administrative workflows.

**Your qualifications should include:**

* Bachelor’s degree. Equivalent experience may substitute for minimum education requirements.
* 3 or more years of experience in business administration, clinical research or healthcare environment

**City of Hope employees pay is based on the following criteria: work experience, qualifications, and work location.**

**City of Hope is an equal opportunity employer.**

jobs.title: VFX Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
Walt Disney Studios is looking for a positive and reliable VFX Coordinator to support and join the VFX team. Responsibilities include screening incoming calls, managing the calendar, meetings, extensive travel arrangements, expense reports, organizing, and handling reroute requests for the VP, VFX.

Successful candidates must have prior experience in film production and VFX.

**Responsibilities:**

* Evaluate weekly Production Reports and perform comparative analyses of key shots and turnover/delivery dates with contracted information, as well as maintain internal reports and databases
* Liaise between VFX Producer, studio executives, vendors, and attorneys to draft contracts for vendors and key VFX personnel. This includes gathering and reviewing all materials (bids, turnover, and payment schedules), and comparing contract language to previous contracts.
* Manage and maintain the VFX Database of Supervisors, Producers, Vendors, and other key VFX crew worldwide (source: current resumes, vendor reels, e-mail correspondences, daily trade papers, and internet research).

* Coordinate between studios, filmmakers, and vendors to arrange VFX reviews for select shows.
* Take notes at reviews as needed, track shot progress, and ensure we stay on schedule for final delivery (for assigned films of VP, VFX).
* Manage VFX shared folders for assigned films, update film files with appropriate updated reports and lists as well as change orders.
* Updates master production calendar for assigned films of VP, VFX involving updates on turnover, shooting, and final delivery dates from vendors.
* Special projects as assigned require analysis and reporting of work processed through executive’s projects.
* Acts as backup to department coordinator when needed to handle routing of purchase orders, invoices for approval, or other assignments as directed.
* Manage publicity and marketing request from vendors, as well as awards submissions for assigned films
* Work with AI toolsets to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and accelerate execution.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 1+ years of experience in film production and/or Visual Effects (VFX).
* Experience in managing a heavy-volume desk.
* File Maker Pro, Aspera, BOX, and Airtable knowledge is strongly preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills, and ability to handle multiple projects under deadline pressure.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal with customer service orientation and tone.
* Handles incoming calls from vendors as needed; coordinates administrative projects as directed.
* Available to work evenings as needed.
* Knowledge of SAP procedures helpful

Under the supervision of the Operations Director, the Events Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for all events at the James Lawson Jr. Worker Justice Center (JLWJC) and is the public face of the Labor Center during events. This position manages the complete event lifecycle, from initial reservation intake through post-event inspection and follow-up, ensuring seamless coordination across 11-15 weekly events ranging from small 3-person meetings to community gatherings of 75+ attendees. The role works closely with staff, students, external partners, and community members to deliver consistent, reliable support. The Events Coordinator works a flexible, adjusted schedule built around the events calendar. Standard hours are Monday-Friday from 8AM to 5PM, supporting daytime events and handling administrative responsibilities. Beyond standard hours, the coordinator is expected to provide on-site coverage for approximately 4 evening events and 5-7 weekend events per month, with the weekly schedule adjusted accordingly. Additional overtime hours may be available depending on operational needs. The ideal candidate demonstrates a genuine commitment to community service and the Labor Center's values, brings exceptional customer service skills, and is warm, professional, and responsive in all interactions. Strong organizational and collaborative skills are essential as the coordinator manages multiple events interfacing with several stakeholders. The role requires reliability, effective communication, and schedule flexibility, particularly regarding evening and weekend availability. The incumbent should be comfortable troubleshooting and problem solving independently during live events, working with scheduling systems, email, and basic office tools, and being on their feet and moving through the facility throughout the day. jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (Outbound Calling & Email)**

Elian Electronics Recycling | Santa Ana, CA | $18/hour | Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM

**About Us**

Elian Electronics Recycling is a certified electronics recycling and IT asset disposition (ITAD) company serving businesses across the entire U.S. We provide free electronics recycling, certified data destruction, paper shredding, and compliance documentation. We’re headquartered in Santa Ana, CA.

We’re a fast-moving, results-oriented team focused on growing our client base, and we’re expanding our outbound team to open new conversations and turn them into customers.

**The Role**

As a Sales Development Representative, you’ll be on the phone with new leads every day, supported by cold email and LinkedIn outreach.

We don’t have a script, and that’s on purpose. We want proactive, intuitive, and resourceful people who enjoy the challenge of building from scratch. You’ll write and refine your own scripts, track what works, and share insights with the team so we all succeed. This isn’t a cutthroat sales floor. We win as a team, and we need people who think that way.

You’ll research companies and the right people inside them before reaching out. You’ll learn our customer segments and build a profile of the ideal customer in each one, which helps sharpen outreach across the whole company. Over time, you may also manage relationships and accounts with the customers you bring in.

**What You’ll Do**

* Cold call: Make a high volume of outbound calls to businesses, get past gatekeepers, reach decision-makers, and book pickups, quotes, and follow-up conversations
* Build and refine scripts: Write your own openers, pitches, and objection responses, then improve them based on what’s actually working
* Research prospects: Find the right companies and contacts, and learn enough about them to make every call relevant
* Track results: Log every call and email, know your numbers (dials, conversations, meetings booked, deals closed), and bring what you learn back to the team
* Follow up: Stay on top of every interested lead until it’s a yes, a no, or a scheduled date
* Cold email: Write and send outreach that warms up leads and follows up on calls
* LinkedIn outreach: Connect with and message prospects to add another touchpoint
* Manage accounts: Over time, maintain relationships with the customers you’ve signed and look for repeat and referral business

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven sales experience: 1+ years in a sales role (outbound, inside sales, B2B, or phone-based preferred) with results you can point to: quotas hit, meetings booked, deals closed. You understand the sales process from first call to close, and you know that listening sells more than talking.
* Comfortable with rejection: Most calls end in a “no” or no answer, and that doesn’t faze you. You don’t take it personally, you learn from it, and you pick up the phone for the next call with the same energy as the first.
* Excellent spoken English and phone presence: You’re clear, fluent, warm, and professional on the phone, and people enjoy talking to you.
* Reading people and adapting: You pick up on tone, pace, and personality in the first few seconds of a call and meet people where they are: straight to the point with a busy executive, friendly and casual with a chatty office manager, patient and informative with someone skeptical.
* Handling objections: You hear “we already have a vendor” or “not interested” as the start of a conversation, not the end. You ask questions, find the real concern, and know when to push and when to move on.
* Goal-driven: You like having numbers to hit, you track your own progress, and you’re motivated to beat yesterday’s results.
* Coachable and curious: You take feedback well, test new approaches, and want to keep getting better at the craft of selling.
* Organized and detail-oriented: You keep systems that make sure nothing falls through the cracks, you catch the small things, and you proactively look for mistakes.
* Spreadsheet skills: You’re comfortable working in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Initiative: You’re a self-starter who finds problems, acts on ideas, and brings results to the team instead of waiting for instructions. You think things through from A to Z.
* Tech fluency: You’re confident in a Windows environment, pick up new software quickly, and troubleshoot everyday tech issues on your own.
* Security awareness: You recognize phishing and social engineering attempts, follow safe habits around passwords and account access, and treat company and client data with the highest care. Data security is central to our business.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with sales and outreach tools (CRMs, email platforms, or B2B data providers)
* Experience selling services to businesses, especially to IT, facilities, or operations contacts
* Familiarity with ITAD, electronics recycling, or data security
* Prior appointment setting or customer service experience

**Schedule and Compensation**

* Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday
* Pay: $18/hour

**About the role**

As an HR Account Manager at Bambee, you lead the HR work for a book of small business clients. You are one of the people owners call when something goes wrong with their people, and you work alongside a Bambee account team to get it resolved.

This is a customer success role for someone who knows HR. You carry a book of business, you spot problems before clients do, and you are measured on client retention and service quality.

Title: HR Account Manager · Reports to: Operations · Location: Los Angeles, fully in office · Type: Full-time, exempt

**What you will do**

* Lead the HR work on your accounts. Get to know each client's business, team and open issues, and be their go-to for HR questions.
* Get ahead of problems. Spot the warning signs in an account, like a missing policy, a move into a new state or an employee complaint, and reach out before the owner has to ask.
* Handle cases start to finish. Guide owners through terminations, complaints, accommodations, leave, pay questions and policy updates, with clear next steps and dates.
* Keep clean records. Document every call, case and decision so the whole account team works from the same picture.
* Keep clients for the long run. Know which clients are at risk and have a plan to keep each one.
* Work smart with modern tools. Use the Bambee platform and modern assistant tools to draft policies and letters, research questions and document cases quickly.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 3 or more years of HR generalist, HR business partner or HR consulting experience, including terminations, investigations, leave and accommodations
* 2 or more years managing a large book of customer accounts in a service business, with retention or renewals as part of your goals
* Experience reaching out to existing clients proactively, not only responding to inbound requests
* A track record of closing a high volume of well-documented cases on deadline
* Working knowledge of California and federal employment law (FMLA, ADA, FLSA, Title VII), and the judgment to know when a client needs an attorney
* Confidence leading video calls with busy, stressed business owners who are not HR experts
* Clear, fast writing
* Comfort using modern assistant tools in your daily work
* Lives in the Los Angeles area and can work from our LA office every day

**Preferred**

* PHR, SHRM-CP or PHRca
* Experience supporting small businesses under 100 employees, where the owner is also the HR department
* Salesforce or another CRM
* Spanish

**How you work**

* You set clear next steps and hit your dates
* You say the hard thing clearly and kindly
* You respond to clients the same business day

**Grit and tenacity**

* Grit. Focus and grit, matched with authenticity and joy. You keep going when the problem is hard and the fix is not obvious.
* Tenacity. You chase the yes. You see opportunity in every problem and stay on it until it is solved.
* Figure it out. Be bold. Do it fast. Do it right.
* Greatness and urgency, together. Moving fast is never a reason to lower the quality bar.
* Thoughtful optimism. Problems do not fix themselves, and every problem is fixable.
* Obsession with your craft. Real passion and real joy in the work.

**Schedule and location**

* Fully in office. Monday through Friday at our Los Angeles office. This is not a hybrid role.
* Two shift options. 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific or 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM Pacific.

**Pay and benefits**

* Base salary: $75,000 to $80,000 per year, based on experience
* Variable pay: tied to performance. With variable pay, this role earns over $100,000 a year.
* Benefits: medical, dental and vision, 401(k), paid time off and paid sick leave
* Growth: room to grow into senior and leadership roles as the team grows

**About Bambee**

Bambee gives small businesses the HR they could never afford to hire: a Dedicated HR Manager, the policies and handbook to run a workforce, and guidance for the hard moments. Our team works together in person in Los Angeles.

We give HR guidance, not legal advice, and we are clear with clients about the difference.

Bambee is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

Work Location: In person

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. Rocket Lab's Supply Chain team is responsible for the flow of all materials, products, and components through the business. They are the chain that links our teams together, and are critical to our success.

Based onsite at Rocket Labs headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Production Coordinator II follows up with production areas for updated status on open work orders, expedites deliveries where needed, and help resolve any blockers preventing on time delivery. Production & Shipping Associate

**Evergreen Cases | Fullerton, CA | On-Site | Full-Time**

***Pay*****:** $18–$21 per hour, based on experience  
***Schedule*****:** 8-hour shifts, Monday–Friday, scheduled between 7:00 AM and 5:30 PM

Evergreen Cases designs and manufactures custom protective cases and foam inserts in Fullerton, California. We take pride in producing high-quality products and delivering excellent service to our customers.

We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and hands-on **Production & Shipping Associate** to join our growing team. This position plays an important role in both manufacturing our products and ensuring customer orders are processed accurately and shipped on time.

We provide structured, hands-on training and machine-specific certifications to help you develop your skills and grow within the company.

* Cut, glue, laminate, trim, chamfer, and assemble foam inserts and protective cases according to specifications.
* Inspect materials and finished products to ensure quality standards are met.
* Identify and report defects, inconsistencies, or other quality concerns before products move to the next stage.
* Maintain clean, organized, and safe workstations and equipment.

* UV printer

* Forklift and pallet jack, following applicable training and certification requirements

Conduct studio tours, provide in-depth explanations of the Pilates Addiction Pilates method, and match clients with the right services based on their goals and needs.

Build lasting relationships with clients, ensuring they feel valued and supported throughout their fitness journey.

**Client Onboarding:**  
Facilitate the onboarding process for new clients, including class sign-ups, membership registration, and ensuring a smooth start to their Pilates Addiction experience.

**Administrative Support:**  
Assist with studio operations, including scheduling, answering calls, managing email inquiries, and processing sales transactions through our POS system.

**Promotion of Events and Offers:**  
Actively promote studio events, workshops, special offers, and retail products to enhance the client experience and boost sales.

Other projects and responsibilities may be added at the owner’s discretion, including administrative duties.

**Qualifications**

* **Sales Experience:** 1–2 years of sales experience, preferably in a fitness or wellness environment.
* **Phone & Lead Follow-Up Skills:** Prior experience calling leads is highly preferred, or a strong willingness to learn and become confident with phone-based sales conversations.
* **Customer Service:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-first mindset.
* **Fitness Passion:** A genuine interest in Pilates and fitness, with the ability to educate others on the benefits of the method.
* **Sales Skills:** Ability to meet targets, handle objections, and maintain a consultative, solution-based approach.
* **Tech Savvy:** Comfortable using studio management software, point-of-sale systems, and digital tools.
* **Team Player:** Collaborative, reliable, and positive.

**Schedule & Availability**

Open availability is strongly preferred, with **particular need for Monday-Friday.**

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to stand, walk, and interact with clients for extended periods.
* Comfortable with light physical activity related to assisting clients and setting up equipment when necessary.

**Perks & Benefits**

* $18/hr + commission
* Free and discounted Pilates classes
* Health & wellness benefits
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A fun, supportive, and high-energy studio environment

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: $18.00 per hour

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, CEO
jobs.description:
**About Altruist**

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

**But first, our values**

**Kindness** - Kindness doesn't *just* equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.  
  
**Brilliance** - Humility is the skill we're most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.  
  
**Grit** - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it's hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

**About the position**

Altruist is entering an exciting phase and we are looking for an organized and resourceful individual who can own the calendar of our CEO and help protect his time. This person will have the ability to prioritize tasks, make sound judgment calls, and is eager to play a key role in a complex, growing, disruptive business.

*This position will be onsite at our Culver City office (4 days per week)*

**What you'll do**

* Work directly with the CEO to support and manage his schedule and all day to day administrative responsibilities
* Provide calendar support to the executive team as needed, especially when meetings also involve the CEO
* Manage the CEO's inbox, ensuring critical messages are reviewed in timely manner and do not "get buried"
* Evaluate and prioritize meeting requests from internal and external stakeholders and respond accordingly
* Draft, review and send communications on behalf of the Executive team
* Own and manage both internal and external scheduling(e.g., weekly business updates, All Hands, Board meetings)
* Coordinate travel arrangements and restaurant reservations when necessary
* Maintain confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion

**What you'll bring**

* Minimum 5 years of experience supporting C-level executives
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to interact with Board members, advisors, and clients in a professional manner
* Strong critical thinking
* Impeccable organizational skills and time management
* Ability to function autonomously in a fast paced environment
* Google Suite experience
* Previous fintech or startup experience preferred but not required

**What we bring**

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we've built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.

* Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.
* Competitive total compensation.
* Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).
* 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.
* 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.
* Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.
* Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).
* Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).
* One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries).

*Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure* *fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.*

*Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role, but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

* Manage your pipeline with discipline, keeping an active proposal backlog and following up consistently to move opportunities forward.

* Ability to quickly identify and qualify opportunities.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

The Operations Coordinator plays a tactical, hands-on role in supporting daily administrative activities under the direct supervision of the Operations Manager. This position focuses on executing specific operational tasks, maintaining efficient workflows, and ensuring that cross-departmental processes run smoothly. The Operations Coordinator assists with data collection, documentation, and tracking of ongoing projects to support performance monitoring and process improvement initiatives. The Operations Coordinator helps identify bottlenecks, implements solutions to improve efficiency, and ensures that departmental operations align with established policies, compliance standards, and organizational goals. The following statements reflect key responsibilities necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and do not encompass all duties that may be inherent to the position.

* Support daily operational activities across departments including medical, dental, behavioral health, pharmacy, vision, and administrative areas to promote efficient workflows.
* Assist in implementing and maintaining standardized workflows to improve productivity, service quality, and compliance.
* Track progress of operational projects and initiatives to ensure timely completion and alignment with organizational goals.
* Help monitor departmental budgets and expenditures, preparing summaries or variance reports for review by the Operations Manager or COO.
* Provide administrative support in addressing and documenting patient complaints and grievances in accordance with organizational policy.
* Coordinate logistics for meetings, trainings, and organizational events, including scheduling, catering, materials preparation, and facility setup.
* Maintain organized records, databases, and documentation to support operational continuity and compliance.
* Assist in maintaining adherence to FQHC, HRSA, FTCA, HIPAA, OSHA, and Medi-Cal/Medicare regulations and standards.
* Gather, organize, and analyze data related to department performance, quality metrics, and resource utilization for management reporting.
* Support the development, documentation, and communication of operational policies, procedures, and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities for operational improvement through data analysis and staff feedback, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and organizational excellence.
* Coordinate with department leads to ensure consistent application of procedures and efficient cross-departmental operations.
* Conduct routine checks of workflows and processes; identify inefficiencies and communicate recommendations for improvement to leadership.
* Assist with preparation of reports, presentations, and documentation for leadership and board review.
* Facilitate cross-departmental communication by scheduling meetings, maintaining shared calendars, and tracking follow-up actions.
* Provide logistical and administrative support for audits, inspections, and readiness activities to ensure compliance with HRSA, FQHC, and other regulatory standards.
* Support property and facility management tasks, including tracking maintenance requests, communicating with vendors, and monitoring lease-related documentation.
* Assist with vendor coordination, procurement activities, and inventory tracking to ensure timely delivery of supplies and services.
* Participate in professional development activities and share relevant updates or process improvement ideas with the operations team.
* Support the Uniform Data System (UDS) reporting process and assist with data collection for compliance reporting.
* Adhere to HIPAA regulations and other relevant laws to protect patient privacy and confidentiality in all communications.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the executive leadership and administration.

Requirements:

**Education, Certification, and Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, or a related field preferred.
* 2–4 years of experience in healthcare operations, practice administration, or related administrative support roles; prior experience in an FQHC or community health setting highly desirable.
* Strong computer skills, including advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Proficiency with electronic health record (EHR) systems and comfort learning new software platforms.
* Working knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements, regulatory standards, and quality improvement processes.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Demonstrated initiative, adaptability, and problem-solving skills in support of operational efficiency and service excellence.

**Language Requirements**

* Spanish speaking preferred

jobs.title: Project Coordinator (Commercial Development)
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Sares Regis Group of Northern California (SRGNC) offers a broad scope of residential and commercial real estate development management services. With our principals having over 40 years of experience providing real estate services in the San Francisco Bay Area, Sares Regis has assembled a staff of remarkable talent from a wide range of related development backgrounds including urban and master planning, entitlements, architecture, various engineering disciplines, construction, project management, real estate development, asset management and financial services. We have developed over 21 million square feet of commercial, residential and mixed-use properties, primarily located throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. Our portfolio consists of a combination of operating assets, developments of our own and fee-based consulting and management services for clients.

**The Role**

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating various tasks to support project teams within the Commercial Development + Advisory (CD+A) group, including administrative support tasks. The position will facilitate and coordinate the work of one or more project teams during the execution of large-scale real estate development projects, and will act as a liaison between internal teams, consultants, vendors, and clients to keep project documentation, budgets, and reporting current.

* Bachelor’s degree is preferred. A combination of education and work experience will also be considered in lieu of degree.
* Two to three or more years of experience as a Project Administrator or Project Coordinator in real estate, construction, or a related industry.
* Experience managing multiple tasks and documents, analyzing data, contract management, and progress reporting.
* General familiarity with project budgeting and cost reporting, with a willingness to build deeper expertise on the job.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as Adobe Acrobat and Procure. Preferred experience in Google Workspace applications (Docs, Sheets, Slides, etc.).
* Demonstrate a reliable, responsive and positive work ethic with the highest degree of integrity.
* Must be highly detail-oriented and committed to quality and accuracy, with critical attention to deadlines.
* Must be a fast learner and logical thinker, with the ability to recall information easily.
* Excellent communication skills, including verbal, written and presentation skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work proactively with clients and the project team.
* Ability to accurately track and report status when managing concurrently running projects.
* Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment, with support from senior team members as needed.
* Proven ability to work effectively both independently and in a team-based environment.
* Demonstrated willingness to be flexible and adaptable to changing priorities.
* Self-starter with strong ownership and accountability, eager to grow into executing with increasing independence over time.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and act quickly.
* Ability to identify potential risk issues early and escalate appropriately to senior team members.
* Willingness to learn and use AI platforms to improve accuracy, quality and efficiency.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Facilitate and coordinate the work of one or more project teams during the execution of large-scale real estate development projects.
* Manage large databases, use reporting tools, and understand how data applies to project deliverables.
* Input and update detailed budgets in a database and complete monthly cost reporting.
* Implement and maintain contract tracking processes and policies, including setting up consultants into the project billing system.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Expansion
jobs.description:
**About Brightidea**
--------------------

Brightidea is the enterprise innovation management platform behind programs at Merck, J&J, AWS, Cytiva, and hundreds of other global organizations. We've been at this for 26 years, we're profitable, which means small surface area, short decision paths, and a lot of leverage per person.

**About the role**
------------------

You own a book of large, under-penetrated Fortune 1000 accounts where Brightidea holds a beachhead — a single department, a single program, a fraction of what the organization could be running. Your job is to crack those accounts open: build executive sponsorship from a small footprint, multi-thread across a complex organization, and grow toward enterprise-wide adoption while protecting what's already in place.

This is a hunter-builder seat, not a caretaker seat. It carries a real number and real accountability.

We've written it deliberately to screen out the standard enterprise SaaS account manager. If your value is relationship maintenance, QBR cadence, and renewal paperwork, this seat won't suit you and you won't enjoy it.

**Why this isn't a traditional Account Manager role**
-----------------------------------------------------

* **You have to build, not just sell.** Our customers are innovation leaders at Merck, J&J, AWS, Cytiva and their peers, and many of them are now building with AI themselves. You'll sit across from people who can prototype, and you need to prototype alongside them — mock a workflow, model a use case, turn platform usage data into a commercial case without waiting on an engineer or an analyst.
* **You have to hold the harder conversation.** A customer who can build their own tooling will ask why they need a platform at all. Answering that credibly means understanding both what we do and what is genuinely hard to replicate. A polished commercial pitch won't survive that conversation.
* **You'll find your own buyers.** Roughly a third of your book is net-new footprint inside existing logos — new business units, new use cases, new executive sponsors who have never heard of us. Nobody hands you that pipeline.
* **The business is changing underneath the role.** Brightidea is evolving how it engages large enterprises, and this seat sits at the front of that. If ambiguity bothers you, this is the wrong company right now. If you want a role where the shape of the work is still being decided, this is a good moment to arrive.
* **You carry a number and own the outcome.** Blended retention plus growth, reviewed monthly with your manager and quarterly with the executive team. The targets are in this document because we'd rather you know them before you apply.

**The bar: AI fluency is non-negotiable**
-----------------------------------------

This is a hard gate, not a preference. We won't make an offer to a strong commercial candidate who isn't genuinely AI-fluent, regardless of track record. We define it concretely:

* **You've built things.** Automations, agents, scripts, internal tools, integrations — something beyond prompting a chatbot. You should be able to walk us through what you built, why, and what broke.
* **AI is in your daily workflow, not your toolkit.** Account research, org mapping, territory planning, first-draft outreach, data analysis. We'll ask how you actually work, and we'll be able to tell.
* **You can produce a working artifact in front of a customer.** A mock, a prototype, a data cut, a solution sketch — fast enough to be useful in the meeting rather than in the follow-up.
* **You can reason about where AI helps and where it doesn't,** including the limits. We need someone who can tell a customer honestly that one thing is easy to build and another isn't.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Treat each account as a mini-territory: build and execute a penetration plan that moves it from beachhead toward enterprise-wide adoption
* Build executive sponsorship out from a single champion or department, multi-threading across large, political organizations where your original contact may not be your path to the budget
* Own renewal negotiation and close, including price increases and multi-year terms against enterprise procurement
* Source net-new buyers inside existing logos — new business units, adjacent use cases, executives who have never engaged with us
* Convert platform adoption and usage data into commercial cases; program results are your ammunition, and you should be able to pull and shape that data yourself
* Position Brightidea credibly against build-it-yourself alternatives, including customers prototyping with AI
* Forecast accurately and keep a clean cadence across ~25 accounts, concentrating effort where the runway is greatest

  

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We care about the combination of commercial instinct and technical fluency, not the label on your last job. Three profiles fit:

* **Enterprise expansion** — you've carried a number expanding inside large, complex accounts, in an enterprise motion rather than SMB velocity. You've grown a logo from one business unit to enterprise-wide, or materially grown ARR inside a named account.
* **Consultant / solution architect** — you've delivered into large enterprises from a consulting or professional services background, with genuine commercial exposure: scoping, pricing, expanding engagements. You're comfortable being the person in the room who designs the answer.
* **Founder / operator** — you've built and sold something, carried revenue responsibility end to end, built your own tooling, and are comfortable with the ambiguity of an evolving business.

**Required across all three:**

* Experience navigating enterprise procurement, renewal negotiation, price increases, and multi-year terms
* Multi-threading in complex organizations, where you've built sponsorship starting from one contact and no budget
* A territory-development mindset with a concrete approach to whitespace

jobs.title: Assistant Account Manager
jobs.description:
Salary – $85K

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Assistant Account Manager – Administrative & Financial Operations provides administrative, financial, personnel-support, and compliance oversight for a 24/7, multi-building Class A commercial high-rise security program.

Reporting directly to the Director of Security, this position is accountable for purchasing, client billing, payroll and timekeeping, workforce scheduling administration, labor cost analysis, training compliance, operational documentation, and management reporting.

Working collaboratively with the Security Operations Manager – Tactical / Field Operations, this position ensures the security program operates efficiently, maintains accurate records, meets contractual requirements, and demonstrates responsible financial stewardship.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Purchasing, Billing & Financial Management**

* Coordinate purchasing, procurement, vendor invoices, equipment inventories, and supply requirements within approved authorization limits.
* Prepare and reconcile client billing, special security services, authorized overtime, and other billable activities.
* Identify billing discrepancies, unbilled services, unnecessary expenditures, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Prepare financial summaries and support contract budget monitoring.

**2. Payroll, Timekeeping & Scheduling**

* Administer payroll and timekeeping reviews, including missing punches, corrections, overtime, and labor exceptions.
* Reconcile employee hours against approved schedules and verified assignments.
* Prepare, maintain, and distribute staffing schedules based on operational requirements approved by field leadership.
* Monitor staffing allocations, schedule changes, vacancies, and labor utilization.
* Ensure timely correction of payroll discrepancies and accurate documentation of all hours worked.

**3. Training Administration & Compliance**

* Coordinate training calendars, onboarding administration, certification renewals, and qualification tracking.
* Maintain employee training records, attendance documentation, licenses, and compliance matrices.
* Identify overdue training or qualification deficiencies and coordinate corrective action.
* Partner with the Tactical Security Operations Manager, who retains responsibility for training delivery, practical assessments, and field competency.

**4. Operational Reporting & Quality Assurance**

* Review Daily Site Reports, incident documentation, supervisory reports, and operational logs for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Identify missing information, recurring deficiencies, and unresolved management action items.
* Prepare operational dashboards, staffing analyses, overtime reports, and management summaries.
* Maintain current post orders, administrative records, and contractual compliance documentation.
* Track identified administrative deficiencies through documented resolution.

**5. Personnel Administration & Management Support**

* Coordinate onboarding records, employee assignments, attendance documentation, and personnel status changes.
* Support administrative documentation for investigations, performance reviews, coaching, and approved corrective actions.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and sensitive operational records.
* Coordinate with Securitas Human Resources, payroll, accounting, and district management.
* Support the Director of Security with client reporting, management initiatives, and process improvements

jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

The Executive Assistant, CTO (EA) will be responsible for directly supporting the Chief Technology Officer and multiple VP-level executives within the CTO’s organization of engineering, information technology, and security, with the primary executive being the CTO who reports directly to the CEO.

You will be expected to deeply embed with the organization to understand how it works from both a technology and people perspective in order to suggest operational changes that truly move the needle.

Support for these senior executives also consists of calendar management, expense management, booking domestic and international travel, and supporting organizational team meetings including but not limited to offsites, engineering events, leadership summits, and all-hands. Support of these senior executives also extend to coordination with their direct reports, such as managing communication channels (Slack, Google Groups) and team meeting cadences.

This role requires a dynamic, highly adaptable individual who can flex their approach based on the needs of each executive and the overall multi-faceted CTO organization. The EA must work fast, be responsive to internal and external stakeholders, anticipate the needs of the team, and seamlessly manage priorities in a constantly-evolving environment.

**This is a full-time, Monday to Friday in-office position based in San Francisco.**

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Provide quality, timely, and detailed administrative support to the CTO and the CTO’s leadership team across engineering/information technology/security, including managing a complex calendar of meetings, processing expense reports, composing and preparing confidential correspondence, arranging travel, and ensuring stakeholder awareness in support of these activities.
* Manage and support calendar coordination for your leader’s direct reports, ensuring alignment across team, cross-functional, and external meetings.
* Thoughtfully manage scheduling requests to ensure effective time management for executives.
* Improve internal and external meeting effectiveness by gathering and tracking key discussion topics, decisions, and action items to develop agendas, document meeting notes, and ensure follow-through.
* Lead planning and execution of leadership offsites, CTO All-Hands, team events, and gatherings owning logistics, vendor coordination, agenda development, and on-site support.
* Identify, design, and implement new processes and solutions to improve team collaboration, efficiency, productivity, and communication.
* Work closely with other EAs to coordinate corporate travel, conference registrations, and office/company/industry-wide events and activities.
* Perform occasional personal tasks and errands for leadership as needed.
* Handle other clerical or administrative duties as assigned.
* Be accessible and available during the traditional work week, with occasional flexibility outside standard hours for urgent matters.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* You have 3-5 years of experience in an executive administrative role at a global tech company, with direct EA experience supporting VP-level or above executives in the fields of Engineering, Information Technology, and Security.
* You collaborate easily across teams. You work well with other EAs and stakeholders within Engineering, Product, Finance, and Workplace teams – building relationships to make things happen.
* You have exceptional communication skills—written, verbal, and interpersonal.
* You exercise discretion and confidentiality with sensitive information.
* You possess strong attention to detail—accuracy in numbers, logistics, and communication.
* You have proven success in planning and executing team offsites, all-hands, or large-scale events.
* You are proficient in Google Workspace – direct experience working with Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Slides and all of their interconnected features.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About AppLovin**

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a smart, hardworking Business Operations Analyst to provide technical and operational support to our Business Operations (BizOps) team and the systems supporting our mobile-advertising business.

A central part of this role is helping other BizOps analysts deliver reliable projects. You will review their code, debug existing workflows, investigate product issues, and translate business problems into actionable requests for Engineering and Operations. You will also write and maintain your own workflow code and analyze product features and experiments.

You will serve as a practical link between business and technical teams. We're looking for someone who learns quickly, investigates problems independently, exercises good judgment, and follows issues through to resolution.

AI-assisted development is a regular part of how our team works. You should be effective at using these tools and reviewing the code they produce, with the technical understanding to identify mistakes, challenge assumptions, and guide work toward reliable results.

### **Responsibilities**

* Support projects led by other BizOps analysts, helping clarify requirements, review technical approaches, and resolve implementation problems.
* Debug issues in existing workflow code, integrations, and data processes. Investigate root causes and implement or coordinate fixes.
* Review BizOps pull requests, including substantial AI-generated changes, for correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with business requirements. Provide actionable feedback and verify that concerns are addressed.
* Write and maintain Python code, SQL workflows, integrations, and automations supporting the team's work.
* Investigate product bugs, distinguish expected behavior from defects, and gather evidence through code, logs, data, and reproducible examples.
* Write clear tickets for Engineering and Operations that explain the problem, business impact, supporting evidence, and expected outcome. Follow up on dependencies and verify resolutions.
* Manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services supporting BizOps workflows, including service accounts, permissions, secrets, configuration, and deployments.
* Support Salesforce workflows and integrations, including programming against its application programming interfaces (APIs).
* Analyze product features, experiments, and operational and advertising data. Apply appropriate statistical methods, interpret results accurately, and explain limitations.
* Investigate discrepancies across internal systems and partner platforms.
* Prioritize competing requests and communicate findings, decisions, blockers, and next steps through concise Slack messages, tickets, and documentation.

### **Qualifications**

* At least two years of relevant professional experience in business operations, technical operations, analytics, software development, or a related field.
* Demonstrated technical ability through a bachelor's degree in a field such as engineering, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or physics, or through substantial technical work, research, or projects.
* Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems, connect information across sources, and work through ambiguous problems.
* A strong work ethic and sense of ownership: you take initiative, persist through difficult problems, and follow work through to completion.
* Good judgment about data quality, system changes, permissions, and operational risk. You recognize which problems you can resolve independently and when additional expertise or review is needed.
* Effective use of AI coding and workflow tools to develop, review, and maintain substantial volumes of code. You can evaluate generated work, identify mistakes, and steer it toward the intended outcome.
* Practical experience with Python, SQL, Git, pull-request workflows, and APIs, including investigating and debugging existing code.
* Hands-on experience managing GCP services and workflows, including permissions, credentials, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Experience applying statistical analysis and data science techniques, including selecting appropriate methods, interpreting results accurately, and explaining limitations.
* Experience in advertising technology, with a working understanding of areas such as campaign delivery, attribution, measurement, mediation, monetization, or the iOS and Android ecosystems.
* Clear, concise written communication. You can explain technical issues in business terms, document reproducible problems, and write requirements and tickets that others can act on.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting internal tools, reviewing other people's code, or coordinating technical work across business, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Experience with Salesforce administration, reporting, permission models, or integrations.
* Experience maintaining production automations, data pipelines, or shared internal applications.
* Familiarity with least-privilege access and sensitive data handling.

### **What Success Looks Like**

BizOps analysts can rely on you to investigate technical problems, review their work thoughtfully, and help their projects move forward. Engineering and Operations receive clear, actionable req

jobs.title: Legal Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**
  
Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry that still estimates by hand. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings manually, and it caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard uses computer vision and NLP to automate takeoffs and estimates, so contractors bid faster and win more. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear, and we're growing fast.

**About the role**
  
You'll be our first legal hire and the point person for everything legal at Bobyard. Today, legal work is spread across our leadership team and five outside law firms, and your job is to bring it into one place. You'll negotiate customer agreements, keep our contracts and terms current, and manage the firms we work with. Success is Sales never waiting on legal, and every matter having one owner and a clear next step.

**What you'll do**

* Be the single point of contact for legal requests: triage, route, and track every matter to closure
* Negotiate and redline customer agreements (MSAs, order forms, DPAs, and NDAs) within our playbook, and escalate what needs outside counsel
* Manage our outside counsel relationships, scope matters, and track legal spend
* Keep contract templates current and version-controlled as pricing and processes change
* Work with Product to keep our terms of service, privacy policy, and in-product terms accurate
* Analyze contract terms against data-privacy, security, and commercial risk, and give leadership clear recommendations
* Build the systems that make legal scale: intake, a clause playbook, and contract management

**What we're looking for**

* 0–3 years in legal operations, commercial contracts, or a transactional practice
* You've redlined or negotiated contracts yourself, not just watched
* You make a call with incomplete information, and you know when to escalate
* You can say no to a salesperson or a customer's lawyer and keep the relationship strong
* Clear, concise writing, and the follow-through to keep many matters moving at once

**Nice to have**

* Juris Doctor (JD)
* Admitted to the California bar
* SaaS agreements, DPAs, or privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA). CIPP/US is a plus
* Contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools
* Startup experience, or a firm serving startups

**What we offer**

* Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.
* $130,000–$155,000 base + 0.02%–0.04% equity (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

**Comp Philosophy**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.

Compensation Range: $130K - $155K

jobs.description:
**Description**

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self-motivated, results-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
* Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical & analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position.
