jobs.description:
Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco — Columbia Park Clubhouse  
San Francisco, CA | [Days], 25 hours/week during the school year and 40 hours/week during summer, in person | Part-time  
$23.50–$24.00/hr | Benefits Eligible

##### **Why This Role Matters**

Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character and community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a School-Based Club team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

##### **What You’ll Do**

Reporting to the Assistant Clubhouse Director, the Youth Development Coordinator supports the Columbia Park Clubhouse by delivering engaging, high-impact youth development programming for members ages 6 to 18. You’ll facilitate learning, arts, and recreation activities, guide positive member behavior, and keep daily Clubhouse operations and attendance tracking running smoothly.

* Facilitate engaging programs — Plan, run, and support age-appropriate educational, creative, and recreational activities, including homework help, tutoring, drop-in games, and technology, arts, and sports projects.
* Grow Learning Center participation — Promote department membership so every Club member actively takes part in Learning Center activities.
* Inspire future goals — Encourage members to prioritize academic success and build post-secondary goals, whether college, vocational training, or a career path.
* Create safe, creative spaces — Facilitate environments that encourage exploration while safeguarding the confidentiality and safety of all members.
* Support daily operations — Assist with school pick-ups, meal and snack service, games room activities, and outdoor recreation.
* Track attendance and reporting — Record daily program attendance and support administrative reporting under leadership guidance.
* Partner with volunteer tutors — Work with volunteer tutors and members to maintain an active educational improvement program.

##### **What You Bring**

###### **Required**

* Demonstrated experience working with youth ages 6 to 18 in a youth development setting
* Ability to quickly build strong, positive relationships with youth
* Strong behavior management and positive discipline skills, with high expectations for members
* Passion for diverse youth programming, including technology, art, sports, academics, and recreation
* Excellent verbal and written communication, research, and organizational skills
* Proficiency with PC software, including Microsoft Office and Adobe Photoshop
* Detail-oriented self-starter with the ability to build and follow systems in a fast-paced environment with continual distractions
* Current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification (or willing to obtain within 90 days of employment)

###### **Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) from an accredited college or university, or equivalent youth development experience
* Bilingual fluency in Spanish and English

##### **Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to lift 25 lbs.
* Must be able to stand for at least 2 hours consecutively.
* Must be able to sit at a computer workstation for long periods of time.

##### **Why BGCSF**

* Comprehensive health benefits, including employer contributions
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Education assistance
* Pre-tax Transportation Savings Account
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Generous Paid Time Off program
* Paid Holidays
* Life & Disability Insurance
* Professional development opportunities
* Free all-location West Coast Bay Club membership (for FT & PT after 90 days)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan: Pre-tax savings program with a discretionary employer contribution for eligible employees after completing one year of service.

##### **Compensation**

The wage range for this position is $23.50–$24.00 per hour. Final compensation is determined based on a range of factors, including skill set, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. Candidates may be hired at the entry, mid, or senior level of the range, depending on qualifications and position requirements.

##### **Pre-Employment Requirements**

As part of the hiring process, BGCSF requires candidates to complete LiveScan fingerprinting, a background check, and a tuberculosis (TB) evaluation or test.

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work expected in this role. It is not intended as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. BGCSF reserves the right to reassign or relocate employees as needed.

jobs.description:
Truebeck Construction is an industry-leading General Contractor serving Fortune 100 companies throughout the West Coast. Founded in the Bay Area, Truebeck has grown to five offices in California, Oregon and Washington. With annual revenue exceeding $1B, Truebeck is one of the top General Contractors in each of the markets we serve. Truebeck provides best-in-class services and builds award-winning projects in the commercial, healthcare, life science, mission critical, education, multi-family, and interiors sectors. Truebeck has developed an impressive portfolio of projects—for prominent companies like Apple, Bloomberg, Meta, Uber, Genentech, and Gilead—and has a long history of consistent growth and profitability.

Our Culture

At Truebeck, a core value is: business and life are all about people. In the office and on the job site, we put people first. Truebeck is consistently ranked as one of the Best Places to Work by local Business Journals, and year after year, we win Excellence in Safety Awards. Our culture is caring, and you’ll see this shine through in employee benefits and opportunities for growth and advancement. We also give back to our community in meaningful ways, and you’ll feel proud to work for a firm that has received the highest recognition as a Top Corporate Philanthropist.

Purpose

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the Project Manager (PM) and/or Project Executive (PX) in managing preconstruction and construction activities, taking on increasing portions of schedule, budget, and client communications. Serves as a liaison role between the Senior Project Engineer (SPE) and PM. APMs are also responsible for providing service and executing decisions to the team at a level where mistakes will cause more exposure and risk to Truebeck. The APM will take the skills acquired from the SPE role and utilize those to manage significant scopes of work for large jobs and a full range of project engineer competencies on smaller jobs with more autonomy.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Project Management**

* Under the guidance of the Project Manager or Project Executive, manage day-to-day operations for assigned portions of the project or small projects.
* Lead coordination of selected subcontractors and suppliers.
* Support development of buy-out road maps and assist with subcontract administration.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing project deliverables prior to client submission.
* Support budget management and forecasting activities.
* Monitor construction progress and lead selected status meetings.
* Ensure project activities align with schedules and profitability forecasts.
* Responsible for working with the Project Superintendent in managing, updating, and implementing project schedule.
* Any other task or duty as assigned or required by the Project Manager or Project Executive.

**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT**

* Maintain and expand positive relationships with owners and architects.
* Represent Truebeck in industry associations and events as delegated.
* Coach, mentor and actively train PEs and Interns on project-specific processes.
* Identify opportunities for additional work with existing clients and communicate them to the PM or PX
* Enhance company relationships with clients and architect through competence, professionalism, and attention to client’s needs.

**Knowledge, Education, and Experience**

* Graduate of a four-year degree program in construction management, construction science, civil engineering or another applicable program.
* Four to seven years’ previous experience working for a General Contractor.
* Full knowledge of computer software, i.e. MS 365
* Experience with Project Controls software (Timberline, Prolog or equal).
* Working knowledge of BIM and scheduling best practices. AutoCAD, Revit, and/or Primavera scheduling software a plus.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good oral and written communication skills.

**Skills and Specifications**

* Have a firm handle on the project, great communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Show strong commitment to the project and team requirements.
* Mentor engineers while supporting the PMs direction of the project.
* Demonstrate the desire to go above and beyond regular activities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage portions of contract documents and building systems.
* Demonstrated growth of business acumen and risk-awareness for project leadership.
* Able to prioritize issues and address those that are most critical to the success of the project.

*Range of base pay is $125,000 - $150,000.*

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

The incumbent typically works in a construction environment where duties will be performed indoors and outdoors. While performing the duties of this Job, the incumbent is regularly exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; outside weather conditions; extreme cold and extreme heat. The employee is occasionally exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock and risk of vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to very loud. Overtime may be required to meet project deadlines.

The employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle or feel, operate a computer keyboard, mouse and other business machines; reach and bend with arms and hands; use eyes to see close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and to adjust focus; climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; stand, walk, talk, and hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit and lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

We are looking for a dynamic and people-driven Executive Assistant (EA) to join our Digital Technology Services (DTS) EA team, providing permanent support to G/VPs. As a part of the DTS EA team, you will work with other DTS EAs and play a pivotal role in keeping the organization running smoothly and efficiently, inspiring morale and team building. Our ideal candidate has executive presence, is highly organized, exhibits great judgment, has high attention to detail, thinks strategically, and is proactive upon the Executive's requests. As EA to DTS Leaders, you will be responsible for a wide range of tasks from assisting with Town Hall meetings, managing both internal and external requests to VPs that align with business needs, planning, scheduling, coordinating leadership travel, and supporting virtual and onsite team events. As a successful candidate, you will be personable, responsible, and trustworthy, and thrive in a fast-paced and exciting environment. This position requires constant communication, high levels of business maturity, confidentiality, and mutual engagement.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the GVP, Chief Information Security Officer.

**Responsibility**

* Serve as a first point of contact for the DTS G/VPs and Leaders
* Develop and maintain systems to prioritize the VP's time and activities
* Anticipate and independently resolve internal and external scheduling conflicts
* Manage a complex calendar that includes: scheduling meetings across various time zones, travel, conferences, earnings, presentations (off-site and/or internal), and group events
* Make comprehensive and end-to-end travel arrangements and process expense reports
* Act as a creative problem solver, liaison, and facilitator in managing support responsibilities
* Draft, review, and edit correspondence, reports, and executive-level presentations with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Collaborate with EAs to the leadership team and provide backup support as needed
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* Bachelor's degree
* 4+ years of relevant professional experience supporting a C-level executive in a fast-paced and demanding corporate environment, preferably with a public technology or SaaS company
* Experience in working with highly confidential information

**Preferred**

* Demonstrated professionalism and discretion
* Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of making appropriate decisions independently
* Can-do attitude, proactive and solution-oriented, consistently looks for ways to add new value and assist the team
* Demonstrated ability to respond to needs quickly and efficiently and prioritize work with a strong attention to detail
* Self-starter who can work with little or no supervision, anticipates the needs of leaders
* Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with a diverse range of people and job functions, including at the senior executive and director level
* Excellent judgment in setting priorities and interacting with internal and external contacts
* Ability to work well under pressure and respond to tight deadlines
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
* Strong focus on customer service, team player mentality, and ability to work collaboratively with business partners
* Proficient in modern productivity software, such as Google Suite; Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Docusign-provisioned Al-assisted apps
  

  

**Wage Transparency**
---------------------

jobs.title: Language Justice Program Coordinator (FT, Temporary)
jobs.description:
About Masa
  
Masa partners with Mexican and Latin American immigrant children, youth, and families in the South Bronx to develop strong learners and leaders who fully contribute to the larger community. We envision a community that is civically engaged, empowered, and educated.
  
Masa’s community-led, integrated model engages the entire family, grounded in a deep commitment to strengthening literacy, leadership, and power for Mexican, Central American, and Indigenous People. Masa fosters a culturally responsive learning community in which families engage with direct service and advocacy programs to dismantle barriers to success.
  
About the Language Justice Program
  
The Language Justice Program seeks to deliver quality language services that empower historically marginalized voices, specifically indigenous speakers of Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). These communities are often hard-to-reach, underserved, and require interpretation and translation services to access critical services. Through this project, we provide economic and workforce development opportunities to Spanish and indigenous speakers by training them as community interpreters while simultaneously addressing the gap in language access for this community. The Language Justice program aims to strengthen our Community of Interpreter Program by training indigenous and Spanish speakers and launching a language services worker cooperative, ensuring this community has access to quality culturally and linguistically competent language services in the long-term.
  
About the Language Justice Coordinator
  
The Language Justice Coordinator will lead the work of our language justice programs, including but not limited to the outreach, recruitment and enrollment of new interpreters, implementation of adult educational classes that support the professional goals of the interpreters such as ESOL and/or Digital Literacy classes, managing the Community of Interpreter Program and dispatching interpretation and translation services, and providing continuous opportunities for interpreters in training to improve their practice. The Language Justice Coordinator reports to the Language Justice Program Manager and under their supervision will work closely with program consultants, trainers, and community members to ensure we continue to provide workforce development opportunities to our community and successfully deliver quality culturally and linguistically competent language services in our Community of Interpreter Program.
  
The ideal candidate will be passionate about language justice and empowering indigenous and immigrant communities; self-driven; possess experience in the area of adult education; and have strong project management skills, including the ability to set goals, plan timelines, allocate and coordinate resources, and manage tasks effectively.
  
This is a full-time, in-person role (40 hrs/week) that is planned to run through June 30, 2027 with the possibility of extension contingent on funding.
  
Key responsibilities
  
Recruitment, Outreach, and Enrollment
  
Coordinate the selection and onboarding process for potential cooperative members
  
Regularly meet with worker cooperative training participants individually to assess their needs, concerns, availability, commitment, training needs, and barriers that affect their participation
  
Provide technical assistance and engage consultants to provide training in business planning, democratic management, governance, legal, cooperative accounting, leadership development, decision-making, collective leadership models and cooperative development best practice
  
Develop a workplan and coordinate weekly working group and bi-weekly group meetings to ensure progress is being made towards successfully incorporating the worker cooperative
  
Remain abreast of and address group dynamics that may hinder progress
  
Support group in developing key documents and procedures for worker cooperative incorporation
  
Secure training opportunities for interpreters to continue to develop their practice and expand their menu of services
  
Maintain accurate records of participants, communications, attendance, progress, and outstanding need
  
Coordinate with organizational leadership and external partners to ensure continued alignment
  
Promote inclusive, transparent, equitable and language-justice-centered practices throughout the worker cooperative development process that ensures indigenous speakers and the original goals of the project are centered at all times and central to the decision-making process
  
Prepare progress updates, reports, recommendations, and documentation regarding the cooperative’s development
  
Requirements
  
Fluent in Spanish and English
  
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Community/Economic Development, or a related field required
  
2–4 years of experience in business development, non-profit program management, community organizing, or working within cooperative enterprises.
  
Strong group facilitation and conflict-resolution skills; ability to simplify complex business and legal concepts for diverse audiences.
  
Familiarity with basic business financial planning, cash flow forecasting, and operational bookkeeping.
  
Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of guiding diverse stakeholder groups toward consensus, especially with immigrant, underserved and marginalized communities
  
Strong commitment to language justice, racial equity, economic justice and experience working directly alongside low-income, immigrant, or marginalized communities.
  
Knowledgeable on the worker cooperative model and collective decision-making frameworks
  
Experience supporting groups through follow-up, planning, outreach, or organizational development
  
Ability to organize multiple participants, activities, deadlines, and records.
  
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and community

The Andrew Carnegie Foundation, originally established as Carnegie Corporation of New York, was founded in 1911 by Andrew Carnegie. Today, our funding supports the issues that Carnegie considered most important: education, democracy, and peace.

Our grantmaking is grounded in Andrew Carnegie’s vision to do “real and permanent good in the world,” and our mission is “to promote the advancement and diffusion of knowledge and understanding.” The award-winning Communications department oversees the content and marketing that tell the story of the foundation and its remarkable grantees. We operate as a combination of newsroom, creative agency, and marketing firm.

**Position Summary:**

The Andrew Carnegie Foundation is seeking an Operations Coordinator reporting to the Chief Communications Officer. The ideal candidate will be a utility player with plenty of initiative: a troubleshooter and problem solver who collaborates easily, takes ownership, and thrives at a fast pace – able to meet deadlines while juggling several priorities. Success in this role is helping the department to operate more efficiently and achieve greater impact. A background in communications and/or journalism is preferable, and strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel is required.

The Operations Coordinator will be responsible for providing administrative, budget, and operational support to a Communications team with twelve members; and will serve as executive assistant to the chief communications officer.

* Assist with organizing events sponsored by the Communications department such as Lunch and Learns and staff photo sessions.

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

**How you'll make impact**
--------------------------

Airwallex is looking for an Account Manager to manage and grow a substantial portfolio of US-based small and medium-sized business accounts. You'll build trusted relationships with founders, CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders while helping customers get more value from Airwallex's global financial platform.

**You'll thrive here if**
-------------------------

* You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you're motivated by stretch goals.
* You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.
* You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.
* You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

Fizz is America’s biggest college social app, allowing Gen Z to connect around their shared experiences and identities. College Fizz communities feature a private, moderated feed of posts from verified students, making it the most entertaining and authentic way to experience student life. The Connectivity division of ICE Fixed Income & Data Services (FIDS) provides network connectivity and colocation services to the global financial industry. Through the ICE Global Network, customers can connect to the family of ICE/NYSE exchanges and clearing houses, access the full suite of ICE Data Services content, as well as connect to an extensive range of third-party exchanges and financial content. jobs.title: Account Manager, Sales
jobs.description:
Town & Country Living is seeking an Account Manager to manage and grow key national retail accounts across one or more product categories.

This role serves as an important link between Sales, the customer, and internal cross-functional teams, helping drive the business from product development and costing through Market (industry trade shows), order placement, production, and delivery. The Account Manager will work closely with Sales leadership to execute account strategies, identify business opportunities, maintain accurate and timely account information, and ensure strong follow-through across all stages of the sales process.

This position will take ownership of the day-to-day business, including account analysis, assortment and pricing preparation, customer communication, development tracking, and cross-functional execution. The Account Manager owns day-to-day account execution and buyer communication; Sales leadership owns overall account strategy, negotiations, and final pricing. The ideal candidate is commercially minded, highly organized, analytical, and comfortable taking initiative while working closely with senior Sales leadership on overall account strategy.

The scope of the role may include ownership across a specific product category or multiple categories/accounts depending on business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

Account Management & Sales

* Own the day-to-day management and growth of assigned national retail accounts and/or product categories, partnering with Sales leadership on overall strategy.
* Develop a strong understanding of each account’s business, including assortment, pricing architecture, historical performance, competitive landscape, and growth opportunities.
* Support the development and execution of account strategies, seasonal plans, and sales initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships with buying teams and serve as their primary day-to-day contact regarding product development, pricing, samples, orders, production status, and other business needs.
* Identify potential incremental sales opportunities, reorders, available-to-sell (ATS) inventory opportunities, and areas of whitespace within assigned accounts.
* Partner with Sales leadership on customer negotiations, pricing discussions, and business proposals. • Prepare for and participate in customer meetings, Market appointments, line reviews, and business reviews.
* Own meeting recaps, next steps, and cross-functional follow-through to ensure commitments and deadlines are met.
* Manage customer requirements, including retailer portals, EDI, routing guides, and vendor compliance standards, to minimize errors and chargebacks.

Sales Analysis & Business Planning

* Analyze sales, inventory, historical performance, and trends to help inform sales recommendations.
* Assist in building account plans, forecasts, budgets, and seasonal sales strategies while monitoring performance against those key targets. Identify opportunities and risks.
* Maintain accurate account reporting, sales recaps, ATS reports, pricing files, and other business tools.
* Partner with Sales leadership to develop account-specific recommendations based on performance, buyer feedback, and market trends.
* Support monthly and seasonal business reviews with clear reporting and actionable insights.
* Help improve account processes, reporting, and ways of working as the business evolves.

Product Development, Merchandising & Costing

* Partner closely with Design, Product Development, Sourcing, Production, and Sales leadership throughout the development process.
* Help build and maintain account-specific line structures and assortments based on customer needs, sales history, and identified opportunities.
* Manage development calendars and key milestones to ensure product, costing, and samples are ready for customer deadlines.
* Work with Sourcing to obtain and maintain accurate costing and partner with Sales leadership to evaluate sell prices and margins.
* Ensure pricing, product specifications, and account information are accurate and aligned across internal systems (NetSuite and PLM/WFX) and working documents.
* Track buyer feedback and ensure comments, changes, approvals, and next steps are communicated clearly.
* Proactively identify development, costing, sample, or timing risks and work cross-functionally to resolve issues before they impact the customer.

Order & Program Management

* Manage programs from initial customer interest through order placement, production, and delivery in partnership with cross-functional teams.
* Oversee item setup, deal sheets, Top Line Sheets, PLM (WFX) data, customer item agreements, and other required account documentation.
* Track purchase orders and production milestones, communicate material changes or risks to Sales leadership and customers, and help drive resolution.
* Partner with Production, Customer Service and Logistics to help ensure orders remain on track.
* Maintain visibility to Pre-Production and top-of-production (TOP) samples, approvals, and outstanding requirements.

Success Measures

* Account sales growth versus plan
* Development, costing, and sample deadlines met on time
* Order accuracy and on-time delivery
* Fewer chargebacks, errors, and rework
* Strong buyer relationships and feedback from internal partners

Requirements

* 3–5 years of wholesale, account management, or related sales experience, preferably within home textiles and décor, fashion, consumer products, or another product-driven wholesale environment.
* Experience working with national retailers, major accounts, or off-price retailers required.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple programs, categories, or projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong commercial instincts and a working knowledge of sales, costing, margin, assortment planning, and account performance.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales and inventory information and translate it into actionab

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Contracts shape how enterprises win customers, buy technology, work with partners, and manage risk. But reviewing them and finding the answers inside still takes too much expert time—slowing decisions across the business. Ivo is building AI that helps legal teams review and negotiate contracts, apply company standards, and turn agreements into actionable intelligence. Our ambition is bigger than making legal work faster: we’re building toward becoming the system of record for how enterprises work with contracts.

As Enterprise Account Manager, drive the growth of AI solutions within large enterprise clients. You’ll own renewals and expansion across major accounts, helping customers realize value and extend it across their businesses. You’ll build relationships beyond the original buyer, uncover opportunities with new teams, and grow adoption of Ivo’s expanding product portfolio—connecting each solution to a real business need. With customers like Meta, Uber, IBM and Intel, and ARR up sixfold in the last 12 months, there’s strong momentum and a playbook still to shape. You’ll help turn that opportunity into lasting, enterprise-wide partnerships.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

* **Take full ownership of Ivo’s largest customer relationships.** Develop and manage named accounts from prospecting to contracting across the business units. Own the commercial health, renewals, and expansion of your accounts, with the judgment and accountability to move them forward without waiting for a playbook. Build a clear view of each customer’s business, the value they’re realizing, and what stands between today’s relationship and a broader partnership. Turn that understanding into an account strategy with concrete priorities, owners, and next steps—and stay close enough to the details to make it happen.
* **Build relationships that create value across the organization.** Earn trust with day-to-day legal users, business leaders, executive sponsors, and budget owners, then extend those relationships into the teams whose work depends on contracts. Understand what each stakeholder is trying to achieve, where their priorities intersect, and where they differ. You’re not collecting contacts: you’re building a network of people who see a meaningful role for Ivo in their business and can work together to make it real.
* **Bring the right people into the conversation at the right time.** Understand how decisions actually get made: who champions change, who controls budget, who needs technical confidence, and who can block execution. Know when to deepen discovery, involve a Solutions Architect or Legal Engineer, equip a champion, or bring executives together around a strategic decision. Give every participant the context and preparation to contribute, anticipate approval requirements, and resolve dependencies before they become last-minute obstacles.
* **Be deeply analytical about where value is—and where it could be.** Partner with CSMs, who lead adoption, to connect usage patterns and customer outcomes with the account’s business priorities. Look beyond headline metrics to understand which teams are benefiting, where workflows still break down, and why promising use cases have not gained traction. Test your assumptions with customers, quantify opportunities where the evidence supports it, and distinguish genuine readiness to expand from interest that has no clear owner, budget, or business case.
* **Turn customer outcomes into a compelling case for investment.** Translate what Ivo helps customers achieve into business terms: less time spent reviewing agreements or finding answers, faster decisions, more consistent standards, and better visibility into contractual commitments and risk. Build credible business cases with clear baselines, explicit assumptions, and outcomes customers can measure. Help champions make the case internally, and lead thoughtful executive conversations about what matters, what needs to change, and why the next investment is worthwhile.
* **Help customers build toward Ivo as their system of record for contracts.** Develop a long-term vision with customers for how Ivo can become central to the way their organization works with contracts—not simply another tool used by one team. Connect that ambition to current capabilities and a practical sequence of use cases across Ivo’s expanding product portfolio. Help customers identify the stakeholders, workflow changes, and internal commitments needed to progress, so better access to contract knowledge positions their teams to move quickly and execute business decisions with confidence.
* **Run disciplined renewal and expansion cycles.** Translate account strategy into opportunities with a clear customer problem, a path to value, stakeholder alignment, and a realistic decision process. Own the commercial cycle through procurement, legal review, negotiation, and close. Surface risk early, maintain an evidence-based forecast, and build shared plans that make the next decision and its dependencies clear. Balance urgency with thoughtfulness: move quickly without skipping the work that makes a commitment durable.
* **Lead across Ivo and turn insight into action.** Bring CSMs, Solutions Architects, Product, Finance, and Legal Engine

**Company Description**

**WHO WE ARE**

*fresh* is a global skincare brand within the LVMH Group, headquartered in New York City. We emphasize the look, feel, and scent in every product, transforming skincare into an elevated, sensual experience. Our collection of skincare, lip care, bodycare, and fragrances are available in 16 countries, across our fresh boutiques and digital channels, specialty and department stores, and more.

We are an organization of curious creators who embrace innovation, optimism, and always keep our customers at the forefront. With a pioneering spirit, we are empowered to challenge the status quo and use our authentic voice to do the right thing for our people, our brand, and the environment.

Here at *fresh*, we intentionally foster a spirit of belonging. We celebrate our diversity and support every employee to feel welcomed, valued, respected, and heard. By embracing curiosity and collaboration, we recognize that our differences strengthen us.

**MAIN JOB OBJECTIVE**

We are seeking an exceptional senior Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative and operational support to more than one C-Suite/Leadership Executives. This role requires a highly proactive, polished, and trusted partner who consistently thinks ahead, anticipates executive needs, identifies potential problems before they arise, and takes initiative to resolve them. The ideal candidate has proven experience supporting more than one executive simultaneously and is a strong multitasker who can connect dots across priorities, manage complex workflows and competing demands, and adapt quickly without compromising accuracy or follow-through. Resourceful and creative, this individual thinks beyond established approaches, offers practical solutions, and identifies opportunities to streamline processes and help create leverage for senior leaders in a fast-paced global environment. Success requires sound judgment, strong business acumen, excellent communication skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to build effective relationships, remain composed under pressure, and distinguish when to act independently versus escalate. Above all, we are looking for someone who operates with discretion, urgency, and ownership, follows commitments through to completion, and serves as a dependable partner while remaining in an Executive Assistant capacity.

 **Job Description**

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage complex and ever-changing day-to-day schedules for multiple executives via Microsoft Outlook, including prioritizing requests, resolving conflicts, and coordinating meetings across multiple time zones.
* Serve as a trusted administrative partner who anticipates executive needs, identifies issues before they arise, and operates with a consistent one-step-ahead mentality.
* Act as a central point of coordination across priorities, meetings, travel, communications, and follow-ups to ensure executives are prepared, aligned, and able to focus on the highest-impact work.
* Prepare executives for meetings and appointments by developing agendas, gathering materials, coordinating logistics, preparing conference rooms and audio/visual needs, and ensuring timely follow-through on next steps.
* Draft, edit, and organize executive communications, presentations, meeting notes, briefings, and other materials with clarity, accuracy, and strong attention to audience and tone.
* Maintain effective document and information management for executives, including preparing, reviewing, organizing, and tracking key records, materials, and action items.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements; prepare detailed itineraries inclusive of flights, visas, hotels, ground transportation, meeting agendas, and relevant briefing materials.
* Oversee executive and departmental expenses, submitting all necessary invoices in Medius and credit card expenses in Concur in a timely and accurate manner.
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with impeccable discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism; know when to escalate, redirect, or protect information appropriately.
* Act as a liaison between executives and internal/external stakeholders, representing leaders with polish, responsiveness, and a strong service mindset.
* Support special projects and operational initiatives as assigned, helping to organize workstreams, track deliverables, and drive timely follow-through.
* Support the planning and execution of company-wide events, leadership meetings, team gatherings, offsites, and employee engagement moments, including coordinating timelines, logistics, communications, vendors, materials, and follow-up actions
* Assist with office management and workplace operations, including maintaining an organized, welcoming office environment; coordinating supplies, space needs, visitor logistics, facilities requests, and vendor support; and helping ensure day-to-day office needs are handled proactively and professionally.

What you will learn in the first 6 months:

* Learn each executive's working style, communication preferences, business priorities, key stakeholders, and expectations for meeting preparation, scheduling, travel, and follow-through.
* Become highly proficient in Microsoft Outlook for advanced calendar management, and master expense systems like Medius and Concur.
* Integrate into the company culture, learning the organizational structure, key internal and external contacts, and relevant company policies.
* Begin to demonstrate a proactive, business-minded, "one-step-ahead" approach by anticipating needs, identifying potential roadblocks, and offering thoughtful solutions.

What you will achieve in 12 months:

* Provide strategic calendar and operational support that enables executives to focus on key priorities, including long-range planning, project coordination, and effective meeting flow.
* Confidently draft and refine memos, presentations, meeting materials, and executive briefing

CSH is looking for a skilled digital marketer and strong writer who can help us reach and engage more people with our work. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (SDR)**
==========================================

Natter is the first AI voice platform for enterprise employee listening. Instead of static surveys, Natter enables real-time, voice-led conversations with thousands of employees - capturing, analyzing, and synthesizing qualitative insight at enterprise scale.

Natter is already being used by some of the world’s largest companies, ranging from big four consultancies like Deloitte and Accenture, global enterprise organizations like LEGO Group and ServiceNow, to technology innovators like Miro.

Natter’s conversational AI platform allows tens of thousands of users to simultaneously share ideas and feedback through real-time video conversations. Its uniquely scalable tech allows anyone with a smartphone to, literally, have a say on the most important decisions - ranging from workplace strategy, sales enablement, to new product offerings.

They have recently closed a $15M Series A and will soon launch Natalie, the world’s first real-time, Conversational AI-Voice Agent for the workforce. Natalie will redefine the future of people listening, engaging employees through live, meaningful conversations and transforming thousands of real-time discussions into actionable insights. These insights inform strategy, transformation, culture, product, and go-to-market initiatives - helping organisations turn employee voice into tangible business impact.

**LOCATION**
------------

**In office**: NYC based, 4 days a week in office. This is a brand-new team and we want to build it in one room: hearing each other’s calls, coaching live, and sharing what works. If you’re looking for a remote or highly flexible role, this one isn’t for you.

**Right to work**: You must already be authorized to work in the US. We can’t offer visa sponsorship for this role.

**COMPENSATION**
----------------

**Base salary**: $75,000 to $85,000

**On-target earnings**: $105,000 to $115,000 ($30,000 variable at 100% of target)

We’re committed to building a diverse team and welcome people from all backgrounds to apply. If you’re excited about this role and our mission but aren’t sure you meet every qualification, reach out anyway. You may be just the right candidate.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We’re hiring Sales Development Representatives to form our first SDR team. Led by a manager who has built and run BDR teams in a similar market and is doing this job himself today alongside our highly experienced GTM Lead and Enterprise AEs.

Most listening tools tell a company what is happening. Our platform uses AI and real-time video conversations to tell them why. You’ll take that to senior HR, People, Sales and Revenue leaders at companies with 2,000+ employees, mostly in the US, with some UK and Europe.

The role is purely outbound and phone-first. Cold calling is about 90% of the job, with LinkedIn and email in support. There is minimal inbound, so the pipeline you build is the pipeline we have.

This is 12 to 18 months of hard, repetitive work, on the phone, in an office. In return, you’ll learn enterprise sales from people who have done it, and take a route designed to lead into a closing role.For the right candidate, this is a place on the founding sales team, with the chance to help write the playbook future SDRs will use.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Cold call VPs and C-suite leaders at large enterprises every day.
* Research accounts and identify the right people to call.
* Handle objections on the spot and explain a nuanced product in plain language.
* Book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.
* Write LinkedIn and email outreach that supports your calls.
* Feed what you hear on the phone back into our target customer profile, messaging and scripts, which are still being refined.
* Work toward a quarterly pipeline target.

**EXPERIENCE:**
---------------

You might be a good fit if you have:

* 0 to 18 months’ experience in B2B outbound sales. Recruitment backgrounds and adjacent experience are welcome too.
* A real appetite for cold calling. You enjoy it, or you’re sure you will.
* The presence to sound credible to senior buyers and to present to a room of executives.
* Quick thinking, with the ability to handle an unexpected objection and keep the conversation going.
* Resilience: you can hear “no” all morning and make the next call with the same energy.
* Drive and ambition, and a willingness to work hard to build your career.
* A bias to action. When something isn’t working, you try something else rather than wait to be told.
* The ability to take coaching and apply it on the very next call.
* A preference for working in an office, alongside your team.
* Exceptional recent graduates with no sales experience are encouraged to apply.
* Evidence of drive outside work, such as competitive sport, running a society, or working through college, is a major advantage.

Legal Operations Coordinator

Vital Strategies is a global public health organization. Our programs strengthen public health systems and address the world’s leading causes of illness, injury, and death. We currently work in more than 80 countries, supporting data-driven decision-making in government, advancing evidence-based public health policies, and mounting strategic communication campaigns. Vital Strategies’ priorities are driven by the greatest potential to improve and save lives. They include noncommunicable disease prevention, tobacco control, road safety, food policy, environmental health, and data for health. Our programs are concentrated in low- and middle-income countries and cities in Africa, Latin America, Asia and the Pacific.

Vital Strategies is committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive (DEI) organization. We believe our programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences, whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.

**Job Purpose:**

The Legal Operations Coordinator is a key member of the global legal team, supporting the day-to-day legal operations including knowledge management, project management, board meeting administration and compliance checks. The global legal team includes the General Counsel, Associate General Counsel and a second Legal Operations Coordinator. The Legal Operations Coordinators act as official liaisons for the legal department, training all new staff and serving as key points of contact for any internal or external requests. This role will work with the team to streamline processes and drive the use of technology and automation systems to optimize legal operations.

* Strong communication skills; communicates clearly and is effective with verbal and written communications; adapts communication style to needs of the audience.

* New York Notary Public Certification preferred (will sponsor and support as needed)

jobs.title: Production Coordinator - Sleepwear
jobs.description:
Description:

Our growing Sleepwear division is seeking an experienced Production Coordinator to manage daily development and pre-production activities for assigned programs. This NYC-based role partners closely with Merchandising, Design, Technical Design, Sales, and overseas teams to keep submissions, approvals, and production milestones on schedule.

The ideal candidate is an organized self-starter with practical apparel production knowledge, strong follow-through, and the ability to work independently, resolve routine issues, and recognize when additional direction is needed.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage the flow of pre-production samples and submissions for assigned programs, from initial requests through revisions and approvals. Proactively follow up with internal teams, overseas offices, and customers to obtain required samples and comments and keep timelines on track.
* Communicate daily with overseas offices on pre-production and production activities, clarifying priorities, tracking outstanding items, and resolving routine issues.
* Maintain time-and-action calendars, key milestones, and production status reports; flag delays or approval issues that may affect production readiness or delivery.
* Support basic production material review, including lab dips and trims, and assist with color and quality comments as needed.
* Check incoming samples and submissions for accuracy and completeness, route them to the appropriate teams, and work with Technical Design on sample needs, fit status, and outstanding approvals.
* Consolidate and communicate submission comments to overseas teams, confirming that revisions address previous feedback.
* Follow up on testing, packaging, and customer-specific requirements with the responsible teams; escalate unresolved concerns with relevant details and propose next steps.
* Maintain accurate and current PLM records, style information, file folders, and approval references, preserving submission history.
* Manage incoming and outgoing sample packages, including tracking, distribution, and shipment follow-up.

Requirements:

* 3–5 years of apparel production experience; sleepwear or knit apparel experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of pre-production and production processes, including sample submissions, approval tracking, time-and-action calendars, and production milestones.
* Familiarity with basic material review, including lab dips and trims, with a good eye for color, quality, and detail.
* Basic understanding of textiles and garment construction.
* Experience communicating with overseas offices or factories and following up with internal teams and customers to move samples, comments, and approvals forward.
* Walmart Private label experience helpful
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience maintaining PLM or similar production systems; AS400 familiarity is a plus.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including maintaining accurate records.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong follow-through, and the ability to prioritize multiple programs, resolve routine issues, and meet deadlines.

**Hybrid Work Schedule**

*4 days a week in the office, Friday work from home*

**New York Pay Rate $65 - 85K**

*We strive to hire and nurture amazing talent. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to experience, specialized skills, and internal alignment.*

**Company Overview**

*Golden Touch is a family owned and operated wholesale apparel manufacturer with a mission to deliver trend focused products for nearly 50 years. We produce private label brands for large mass market retailers across the globe specializing in children’s, junior, missy and women’s apparel.*

**Diversity Vision Statement**

*We are committed to creating an inclusive environment that welcomes and values the differences among all of our associates, customers, suppliers, and the communities in which we live and conduct business. We are an equal employment opportunity for minorities, females, protected veterans, and the disabled.*

*We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and treating our associates and applicants without discrimination based on their race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.*

jobs.description:
**About Wonder**

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on-site by our culinary team and served hot.

Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

**About The Opportunity**
-------------------------

Wonder is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and strategic Executive Assistant to support key executive leaders—specifically supporting two CEOs who oversee our largest business units, our CTO, and other executives. This role serves as a trusted partner to executive leadership, managing complex administrative operations, communications, scheduling, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, exercises exceptional judgment and discretion, anticipates needs before they arise, and brings a high level of professionalism, curiosity, and operational excellence to everything they do.

This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role in supporting executive leadership while helping drive organizational effectiveness and operational efficiency across Wonder.

**The Impact You Will Make**

**Executive Partnership & Calendar Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Provide high-level administrative and operational support to CEO, CTO and other C-Suite level leaders
* Manage complex executive calendars, prioritizing competing demands and aligning schedules with business priorities
* Coordinate and support executive meetings with internal and external stakeholders, including board members, investors, and senior leadership
* Anticipate executive needs, proactively solve problems, and improve administrative workflows and processes
* Track priorities, deadlines, deliverables, and follow-up items with minimal direction
* Serve as a trusted liaison across internal and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless coordination and communication

**Communication & Documentation**
---------------------------------

* Draft, edit, proofread, and distribute executive communications, presentations, and messaging for a variety of audiences
* Communicate professionally and effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including executives, board members, investors, and external partners
* Maintain highly confidential information, files, records, and correspondence with discretion and professionalism

**Meeting & Event Coordination**
--------------------------------

* Plan and coordinate executive leadership meetings, business reviews, offsites, town halls, and strategic planning sessions
* Manage meeting logistics including scheduling, room coordination, vendor management, agendas, materials, and follow-up actions
* Support both virtual and in-person meetings across multiple time zones and locations
* Assist with coordination of board meetings and executive-level events as needed

**Office & Operational Excellence**
-----------------------------------

* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, itineraries, and related logistics
* Prepare and process expense reports, invoices, budgets, and administrative documentation
* Ensure efficient day-to-day operations of the executive offices and contribute to a positive team environment
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and administrative processes across the organization

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 4-6+ years of experience supporting C-level executives, preferably within fast-paced or high-growth environments
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong judgment, discretion, and professionalism handling confidential and sensitive information
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
* Proven ability to anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and operate independently
* High attention to detail and strong follow-through
* Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive, with experience operating within a highly collaborative Google-based work environment
* Experience supporting executive leadership in finance, operations, technology, or high-growth startup environments is a plus

**Got These? Even Better:**

* Experience coordinating board meetings, investor communications, or executive-level presentations is preferred
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred

As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role.

This role requires a minimum of 4 days a week in the office, with additional days as needed based on role demands.

**New York:** $96,000-$114,500 per year.

**Illinois:** $86,500-$103,000 per year.

Wonder uses geographic-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

**Benefits**

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parent

jobs.description:
**Assistant Project Manager, Interagency Coordination, Division of Building and Land Development Services**
===========================================================================================================

* HOUSING PRESERVATION & DVLPMNT

Posted on

10/20/2026

* Full-time

Location

NYC-ALL BOROS

* No exam required

Department

EXECUTIVE OFFICE, BLDS

Salary range: $62,868.00 – $72,298.00

Save

**Job Description**
-------------------

Agency Description:
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.  
  
  
  
Your Team:
  
  
The Office of Development (OOD) leads the agency’s effort to create and preserve affordable housing in collaboration with other HPD offices as well as other city, state and federal agencies. The OOD is comprised of eight divisions that administer a range of programs. These divisions include New Construction Finance, Special Needs Housing, Housing Incentives, Building and Land Development Services (BLDS), Homeownership Opportunities and Preservation, Preservation Finance, Portfolio Management and Conversions, and Compliance and Enforcement.  
  
  
  
The Division of Building and Land Development Services leads the agency’s effort in providing architectural, engineering, cost valuation, environmental planning, and construction support services to the various divisions within OOD. The Office of Development utilizes a public-private partnership model and provides loans, grants and/or incentives to assist in the finance of housing development projects that will benefit low- and moderate-income New Yorkers.
  
  
The Division of Building and Land Development Services is the largest division within the Office of Development with over 100 staff composed of seven units which include: the Bureau of New Construction Design Review Services, the Bureau of Preservation Design Review Services, the Bureau of Engineering, the Bureau of Construction Services, Environmental Planning Unit, the Policy Unit, and the Program Management Unit.
  
  
Your Impact:
  
  
As part of the BLDS Executive Office, the Assistant Project Manager, Interagency Coordination, will be responsible for assisting the team leading the Agency’s efforts to implement the city-wide housing initiative known as Accelerating and Streamlining Affordable Production (ASAP).
  
Your Role:
  
This role involves providing support to the Director of Interagency Coordination who will coordinate with internal and external partners and stakeholders to address various complex issues to further the ASAP housing initiative focused on interagency coordination for a large pipeline of HPD-financed affordable housing projects.
  
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
  

* Support the Director of Interagency Coordination with the division’s efforts in achieving the Agency’s and Division’s goals and objectives of accelerating the production of affordable housing.

jobs.description:
Natural Sciences Publishing (NSP) is an academic publishing company specializing in scientific journals, research publications, and scholarly content across mathematics, statistics, computer science, and other scientific disciplines.

Our mission is to support the academic community by facilitating the publication and distribution of high-quality research materials.

We are seeking a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented **Production Assistant** to support daily publishing operations, coordinate production materials, and help ensure that scientific publications are prepared accurately and efficiently.

Position Overview

The Production Assistant supports various stages of the academic publishing process, including manuscript preparation, document organization, formatting assistance, quality checks, production tracking, and publication coordination.

This position involves working with editorial and production teams to maintain accurate records, monitor deadlines, and ensure publishing materials meet established quality standards.

The ideal candidate is organized, attentive to detail, comfortable working with digital documents, and capable of managing multiple assignments in a deadline-driven environment.

Previous publishing experience is helpful but not required.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist with daily publishing and production operations.
* Prepare, organize, and review manuscripts and publication materials.
* Support document formatting, proofreading coordination, and layout preparation.
* Check publication files for completeness, consistency, and formatting accuracy.
* Maintain organized digital records, production schedules, and project documentation.
* Track manuscript progress and assist with meeting publication deadlines.
* Coordinate routine production requests with editorial staff and external service providers.
* Assist with preparing journal issues, articles, and supporting materials for publication.
* Review tables, figures, references, and supplementary files for completeness.
* Identify formatting inconsistencies and report production-related issues.
* Support quality control procedures for digital and print-ready publications.
* Update internal tracking systems, spreadsheets, and production reports.
* Organize electronic files and maintain accurate version control.
* Assist with publication distribution and administrative coordination.
* Perform additional production and operational support tasks as needed.

Qualifications

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Good written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to follow instructions and established production procedures.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar applications.
* Comfortable working with digital documents, spreadsheets, and electronic records.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Strong teamwork and problem-solving skills.
* Dependability, professionalism, and willingness to learn.
* Previous experience in publishing, document production, administration, or editorial support is preferred but not required.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with academic publishing or scientific journals.
* Basic experience with document formatting and proofreading.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Adobe Acrobat, or similar document tools.
* Familiarity with publication workflows, manuscript tracking, or digital publishing platforms.
* Basic understanding of PDF preparation and quality control.

What We Offer

* A professional and collaborative publishing environment.
* Opportunities to develop academic publishing and production skills.
* Experience supporting scientific journals and research publications.
* Exposure to editorial workflows, document preparation, and publication coordination.
* Opportunities to learn new processes and expand professional responsibilities.

Join Our Team

At **Natural Sciences Publishing**, accuracy, organization, and attention to detail are essential to supporting quality scientific publications.

As a Production Assistant, you will contribute to efficient publishing workflows, help maintain production standards, and support the preparation of research materials for publication.

If you are dependable, detail-oriented, and interested in developing your career in academic publishing, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager - ATLANTA
jobs.description:
ViiV Healthcare is a global specialty HIV company, the only one that is 100% focused on researching and delivering new medicines for people living with, and at risk of, HIV. ViiV Healthcare is highly mission-driven in our unrelenting commitment to being a trusted partner for all people living with and affected by HIV. Our aim is to think, act, and connect differently through a focus on education on for the prevention and treatment for HIV. We go to extraordinary lengths to deliver the sorts of breakthroughs, both in prevention, treatments, care solutions and communities, that really count. We go beyond the boundaries of medicine by taking a holistic approach to HIV through developing and supporting sustainable community programs and improving access to care. We are fully committed to push through every challenge until HIV/AIDS is eradicated. ViiV Healthcare has played a significant part in delivering breakthroughs that have turned HIV into a manageable health condition. We offer the largest portfolio of HIV medicines available anywhere, and we continue our work to cater for the widest possible range of needs in response to the HIV epidemic.

We are aware of how much is at stake for those at-risk or affected by HIV and we show up every day 100% committed to the patients. Our work culture is fast-paced, diverse, inclusive, competitive, and caring. But ViiV Healthcare isn’t just somewhere to work – it’s a place to belong, an invitation to bring your very best, and a team full of impact-driven team members who are hungry to make a difference.

While we have been improving lives of HIV patients for 30 years, this is an especially exciting time to be at ViiV Healthcare, as we evaluate novel approaches to treatment and prevention that could further reduce the impact of HIV on individuals and communities.

ViiV Healthcare is seeking an experienced, results-driven professional in Specialty Sales for the position of **Territory Account Manager (TAM)** on the long-acting HIV Injectable Treatment Sales team. The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, complex environment and work with HCPs to adopt a new approach to HIV treatment will be essential to delivering success in this role. Additionally, the abilities to partner cross-functionally and to remain highly adaptable in a launch context will be critical. It is expected that the successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in developing strategic business plans with specific, measurable, action-oriented objectives in accordance with territory and account level goals. Successful outcomes will include selling to HCPs, servicing their accounts, and being aligned to ViiV Healthcare’s mission of leaving no person with HIV behind. This will be achieved through driving results against business objectives and working effectively within an integrated account management framework in the setup and delivery of a buy and bill treatment model.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career, these responsibilities include some of the following:

* Deliver Results Through Exceptional Sales and Service
* Identify, target, and win new business by influencing working with HCPs to adopt a new approach to HIV treatment
* Engage with HCPs, nurses, staff, and administrators to accurately understand the clinical, organizational, and financial challenges and opportunities within target accounts
* Leverage data analytics, business acumen, and market expertise to identify high-priority prospects
* Prepare and execute business plans that are tailored to the unique needs of each customer and that help HCPs scale their treatment model to reach more patients
* Coordinate, engage, and partner with multiple cross-functional team members (i.e., Clinical Nurse Educators and Field Reimbursement Managers) to deliver an integrated product experience to customers
* Maintain a portfolio-based selling mindset and close internal communication loops to ensure customers experience a cohesive, integrated ViiV
* Provide exceptional customer service by proactively anticipating and addressing HCP problems, needs and requests
* Deliver and adapt execution plans to achieve performance goals and objectives utilizing; KPIs, scaling of successes, business problem solving, etc.
* Develop and foster external relationships with key influential customers and thought leaders
* Compliance, Accountabilities, and Values Based Culture
* Act in ways consistent with ViiV’s culture, expectations, and values
* Be an agent of change by embracing the ambiguity in a launch environment and seeing setbacks as opportunities to learn and grow
* Escalate issues and risks when needed; display courage by ‘speaking up’
* Understand and follow key compliance and regulatory guidelines

**Why you?**
============

**Basic Qualifications:**

*We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:*

* BA/BS degree
* 5+ years of pharmaceutical sales experience
* 3 plus years’ specialty experience
* Ability to travel domestically as necessary, which may include overnight travel, majority of time will be spent in market
* Valid Driver's License

**Preferred Qualifications:**

*If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:*

* Degree in Business, Marketing, or Life Sciences
* Strong planning and organization skills, analytical ability, business acumen, decision making ability, and problem-solving skills
* Experience to influence and collaborate cross-functionally in a matrixed environment
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Experience in sales success in complex market access coverage situations
* Experience working with HCPs to procure, manage, and administer cold chain treatment products
* Knowledge of the HIV treatment and/or prevention markets
* Bilingual in Spanish, preferred but not required
* Experience partnering cross functionally within an integrated account team model that includes multiple field-based team members

jobs.description:
**FLEXETC | FULL-TIME | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX or Atlanta, GA (based in either market) | Light travel**

**COMPENSATION:** $100,000 base + annual performance bonus opportunity up to $15,000

**Build something with FlexEtc**

FlexEtc provides private warehouse suites, flexible workspaces and shared amenities for growing businesses. Across our U.S. locations, we help contractors, e-commerce brands, makers and other entrepreneurs find space to operate and grow. We are a lean, expanding company where people own outcomes, move quickly and work closely with local teams.

**The opportunity**

Be the hands-on owner of search-driven demand generation across FlexEtc locations. Success means more qualified tours and leases at an economically sensible acquisition cost—not just clicks and impressions.

**What you will own**

* Plan, run and optimize Google Ads, relevant Meta campaigns, and location-level budgets.
* Improve Google Business Profiles, local search visibility, location pages, reviews and technical/on-page SEO.
* Build or direct landing-page tests and improve conversion from visit to qualified inquiry.
* Maintain GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, call tracking and HubSpot attribution.
* Coordinate with sales to reconcile leads, qualified tours, completed tours and signed leases.
* Report weekly on spend, qualified leads, completed tours and acquisition cost by location; reallocate based on results.
* Launch location-specific acquisition programs ahead of new openings.

**What you need to succeed**

* Direct ownership of Google Ads and SEO with verifiable outcomes: spend, lead quality, qualified tours or appointments, conversion rate, and acquisition cost; able to distinguish paid-search volume from high-intent lead quality.
* Working ability with GA4, Tag Manager, Search Console and conversion tracking.
* Comfort owning execution rather than primarily directing agencies.

**Helpful, not required**

* Multi-location local-service or commercial real estate marketing.
* HubSpot, landing-page experimentation and reporting/dashboard tools.

**What success looks like**

You establish a measurable baseline in your first 30 days, present an action plan with your manager, and demonstrate quantifiable progress in the first 90 days. Role-specific targets will be agreed during onboarding.

**Compensation and benefits**

$100,000 base + annual performance bonus opportunity up to $15,000. Health insurance and paid time off. Bonus is performance-based, subject to plan terms, and is not guaranteed. Additional benefit details will be shared during recruiting.

**How to apply**

Submit your resume and a redacted campaign case study showing actual spend, search strategy, conversion tracking, before/after qualified leads or tours, and cost per acquired customer (or signed lease). Be prepared to discuss campaign reports during interviews. Selected candidates can expect an initial screening, a hiring manager interview, and a final discussion. FlexEtc is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
